page: Microsoft Azure E372is_v7 is an isolated, memory-optimized instance powered by Intel x86_64 processors and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 372 dedicated virtual CPUs and 2832.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.61 GB of memory per core. The instance contains zero discrete GPUs, focusing entirely on large-scale CPU and memory capacity for enterprise workloads requiring single-tenant host deployment.

Storage architecture on the E372is_v7 does not include bundled local disk space. Deployments rely entirely on remote block volumes, supporting Azure Premium Storage for system and application data. This setup ensures data persistence is decoupled from compute hardware, though disk throughput depends directly on remote storage configurations. As an isolated tier, the host environment offers dedicated physical hardware allocation without resource contention from other tenants.

Given its massive 2.8 TB memory footprint and 372 dedicated execution threads, this server fits large in-memory databases, SAP HANA and enterprise ERP backends, high-concurrency transactional database management systems, and memory-intensive data analytics pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E372is_v7 is an isolated, memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V with x86_64 Intel processors. Designed for massive enterprise deployments, it features 372 dedicated vCPUs and 2832.0 GB of system memory, delivering roughly 7.61 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or local disk storage, necessitating remote volumes such as Azure Premium Storage for operating systems and persistent data. Because it runs as an isolated instance, single tenants receive dedicated physical host hardware, avoiding multi-tenant resource contention. The hardware architecture offers immense compute density and a substantial memory footprint, making it suitable for demanding in-memory databases, large relational database management systems, enterprise resource planning suites, and large-scale data analytics pipelines that require substantial memory capacity across hundreds of processing threads.
